This file is optional metadata. Everything below is also in the HTML of the pages it points at.

## Start here

- [Email the desk](mailto:contact@samedaydesk.com): Bring the hard part.
- [For agents](https://samedaydesk.com/for-agents): machine interfaces as documentation.
- [Published self-audit](https://samedaydesk.com/audit/samedaydesk/2026-08-19/): frozen 2026-08-19 evidence pack, kept as historical proof, not the current homepage offer.
- [Terms](https://samedaydesk.com/terms): legal terms.
- [Methods](https://samedaydesk.com/methods): measurement notes for existing checkout pages, not the homepage offer.
